view: Frontal chest radiograph (likely PA, upright); 'L' side marker at the upper right of the image confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate: ~9-10 posterior ribs visible (good inspiration), minimal rotation (clavicles roughly equidistant from spinous processes), adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through the cardiac shadow). Scapulae partly overlap the upper lateral lung fields; large bilateral breast shadows overlie both lower zones and reduce conspicuity at the bases. No cropping.

devices.type: External side marker 'L' with technologist initials 'DG' (no lines, tubes, clips, pacemaker or jewellery)
devices.location: Upper right corner of the image, i.e. patient's left, outside the chest

abnormalities.finding: Well-circumscribed round pulmonary nodule, ~2.5 cm, lateral to the right hilum (projected over anterior 4th rib)
Dense, rounded right hilum ~3.5 cm containing multiple punctate calcifications - calcified hilar lymph nodes / granulomatous change

Well-defined homogeneous oval mass-like opacity ~4.5 x 3 cm in the peripheral left lower zone at the anterior 5th rib level (pulmonary nodule/mass; nipple or cutaneous shadow to be excluded with markers/CT)

Left hemidiaphragm ~1 cm higher than the right, with a large gas- and food-debris-containing gastric shadow directly beneath it (distended stomach; diaphragmatic hernia / intrathoracic stomach cannot be excluded on frontal view alone - no definite retrocardiac air-fluid level)

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（疑為PA直立位），吸氣量足夠、無明顯旋轉，雙側大乳房陰影重疊於下肺野；未見任何導管、引流管、心律調節器或金屬夾，僅影像右上角可見 L 側別標記。右中肺野外側可見一約2.5公分邊緣清楚之圓形結節，右肺門呈約3.5公分含多發點狀鈣化之緻密影（鈣化肺門淋巴結）；左下肺野外側另見一約4.5×3公分邊緣清楚之橢圓形腫塊狀陰影，需與乳頭或皮膚陰影鑑別。心臟大小正常、縱膈不寬、氣管居中，雙側肋膈角銳利，無肋膜積液或氣胸；左側橫膈略高於右側，其下方為含氣及食物殘渣之擴張胃泡，未見明確心後氣液面，建議加照側面片或CT進一步評估；骨骼及軟組織無其他異常。
